scripts.build: npm run generate:clients && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node scripts/build-web.mjs
scripts.generate:clients: prisma generate --config apps/commerce/prisma.config.ts && prisma generate --config apps/billing/prisma.config.ts && prisma generate --config apps/bank-simulator/prisma.config.ts
scripts.validate:schemas: prisma validate --config apps/commerce/prisma.config.ts && prisma validate --config apps/billing/prisma.config.ts && prisma validate --config apps/bank-simulator/prisma.config.ts
scripts.format:check: prettier --check apps packages scripts tests infrastructure compose.yaml compose.dev.yaml compose.verify.yaml package.json tsconfig.json
scripts.format: prettier --write apps packages scripts tests infrastructure compose.yaml compose.dev.yaml compose.verify.yaml package.json tsconfig.json
